extension_terms.definition: The source-written structural surface pattern of a composition, distinct from any realized surface form.
extension_terms.source_justification: The Modular adjunct source row explicitly records the pattern 'scope marker + (V_NC_N) + (V_NC_M) + V_N/V_H' while recording no concrete surface form.
extension_terms.skos_gap: A construction pattern is not a SKOS concept label, notation, or semantic relation.
extension_terms.rdf_gap: rdf:value is already used for exact realized New Ithkuil surface form; reusing it for structural patterns would erase the source role distinction on concrete rows that carry both.

extension_terms.definition: The source-stated realization condition that constrains a composition resource.
extension_terms.source_justification: The source row states that the default form is replaced by the listed alternant when immediately preceded by y.
extension_terms.skos_gap: A realization condition is not a SKOS semantic relation or concept annotation role.
extension_terms.rdf_gap: dcterms:description is used for the source semantic summary; flattening an operative realization condition into the same property would lose its machine role.

extension_terms.definition: The source-declared number of linguistic components in the composition; #58 separately owns the component edges and their order.
extension_terms.source_justification: The Standard formative source row declares component_count 9 and composition_components.csv contains exactly nine rows for that composition.
extension_terms.skos_gap: SKOS has no predicate for the cardinality of linguistic construction components.
extension_terms.rdf_gap: Generic rdf:value is already the principal realized surface value and RDF container membership would prematurely own #58 component edges; DCMI extent denotes size or duration rather than this source cardinality.
